title: KHR_mesh_primitive_visibility_hint glTF Mesh Primitive Extension
description: Associates one mesh primitive with a non-inherited per-view visibility role, combined with its containing node's ancestor-inclusive hint visibility. Evaluating the predicate does not alter glTF-authored or animated data; the implementation technique is not prescribed.

role.description: Nonempty visibility role. The exact standard values are 'always', 'first_person', and 'third_person'; any other value is a custom role, and the specification recommends that a consumer not render a primitive whose role it does not support. The individual role predicate is true for 'always' in every render view, for 'first_person' only in views tagged 'first_person', and for 'third_person' only in views tagged 'third_person'. The containing node's ancestor-inclusive hint visibility and KHR_node_visibility can still hide the primitive; 'always' cannot cancel an ancestor's restriction.

label.description: Nonempty human-readable label, preferred over role whenever a host or tool presents the hint to a user. It has no effect on visibility.
